I had a bit of anxiety - this was our first time there &
Kisses the cat can sometime “difficult” but the Dr & staff were awesome.  She was much calmer coming out of the office than going in!  Plus with reasonable rates & great hours it was a win.
Polite and kind
Teddy Bear is doing great because of all of you

Visit this place; they take great care of your pets and are very attentive. The only thing I didn't like was the prices; they should be more affordable for pet owners. Not everyone can afford the amount they charge for the procedures. Now I'm going to give my new opinion because I had a bad experience with my dog, who developed a hernia. I had been treating him for months, and the vet told me there was no need for surgery because the mass wasn't a problem. I wasn't reassured, so I sought a second opinion, and it turned out that the hernia he called a mass did need surgery. Besides, I paid a lot of money, and my Sam ended up in the same condition. On top of that, they treated him for vomiting, and it turned out Sam has a sensitive stomach. The vet told me it was because he got very excited. I started with a good experience and ended with a bad one.

I’ve been bringing my dogs here since 2022, and I couldn’t be happier with the care they receive. Both of my senior baby’s have had surgeries here. The doctor and staff have always been kind to us. They really do care about our fur babies , I will highly recommend them to take care of your fur babies

I've been going here for years for my cat Mimi, and mainly for wellness exam and rabis shot. I chose it initially because of its location and it has been okay, but my last visit few days ago was great. Dr. Podduturi took his time to explain and talk to me about my concerns and estimated costs for potential visits. He didn't seem to be in a rush and was friendly. I just wish there was a protocol that would allow me to see my cat while she's being examined. I also never received a receipt of summary visit like copy of notes that includes her weight and maybe other findings like I asked... Other than that, everything went well and the staff are friendly. The waiting time wasn't so bad.
The Doctor is very knowledgeable and you can tell he loves animals. The staff are sweet and friendly.
They want 90 for well exam and 30 for 1 shot 130$  got to emiancepet
Easy and fast make appt really take care of my cat dr called me back very quick with test result

Great place to take your injured pet
great placve

I'm very happy with the care my dog receives here.
You guys are the best. You saved my cat, Mimo, and treated us like family. Thanks so much!

I was told 200 for the vist, It cost me 417 dollars and A 1000 for dental work, when I came to get the work done the estimate was 1600-2100  I couldn't afford that,  the dog was my girl friends, who passed away he is 10 years old. When I ask why the price change? I was told A different vet gave me the estimate that was not there that day of the surgery!!!!;  what A rip off!!!
Was wonderful!!!

I came here with my sister, and her pitbull who had an ear infection. The doctor was very polite, and informative. The problems came at the end when she got the bill. They trimmed his nails, that service fee is apparently $45. Pretty much everything she needed was $45 and up. They should tell you how much things are upfront so that their are no surprises. That's my suggestion. Ask how much for any and everything that they do.
Fast service

I highly recommend Pet Health Center! As a first-time fur parent, I was thrilled by the support they provided for my little one. When I called, the staff member was incredibly professional and compassionate, which made a huge difference when I felt overwhelmed about my fur baby's needs. She was very helpful in scheduling an appointment and even found morning openings for us.

The prices at Pet Health Center were reasonable, especially compared to other places I contacted that seemed more focused on profits than care. It's comforting to know that a facility genuinely cares about the well-being of our pets. They truly became a support system for my family during a time when we needed it most. If you're looking for a place that prioritizes care over costs, Pet Health Center is the place to go!

Dr. Podduturi is very knowledgeable, and the vet techs here are fairly laid-back. I have a difficult, and senior dog who I have brought here twice now for a regular visit and an emergency one, and both times I've felt satisfied with the care he received. The first visit felt a little tense, I'm sure due to my dog having history with the clinic and not being the best behaved boy as he is technically adopted by me but has gone to the clinic a few times prior, and I felt a degree of the doc not being too happy at the state of my dog. Fast forward to my last visit that ended up being an emergency one, the atmosphere of the visit was way different. Both times they helped my dog and helped me walk through what was going on, what was needed, and how to solve it along with price ranges and estimates. Both times, they called me next day to check in on my dog and see how he was. Thank you for your care of my boy.
I would prescribe this practice as a hidden gem. The doctor can do different types of procedures including dentistry. The staff are very kind and welcoming. I would come back again.

Originally took my cat here for a routine check up about a year ago. We had him for about a year at that point. During the check up the doctor made a recommendation to take my cat off of the medication he was on when we adopted him. We were told at the time of the adoption that he would be on this medication forever. As a result, our cat had way more energy! I was immediately impressed at the attention to detail and knowledge base.

Fast forward a year, and my cat needed an immediate appointment for dental pain. He stopped eating and I was really concerned. The receptionists got me scheduled same-day and even moved up my appointment so that I could get my cat in sooner. Doctor was quick to diagnose his issue, and recommended oral surgery. The vet tech explained his medications thoroughly.

He provided me with a low-end and high-end estimate, and booked me for the next day. I spoke with coworkers, and the quote I was given was VERY reasonable. The surgery was successful took half a day. Within 24 hours I went from worrying for my cat’s health to relieved that it was fixed. The price ended up being on the low-end as well, which was a bonus. The people here do great work, and they care.

I would recommend Pet Health Center to anyone looking for fairly priced, knowledgeable, and efficient veterinarian.

The Pet Health Center was one of the worst vet experiences I’ve ever had. I wish I could give them zero stars. They advertise as low-income friendly, but charged me $500 just for blood work on my cat. That’s an insane price especially when other vets like Fishtown Animal Hospital charge way less for the same service.

My cat was diagnosed with diabetes. They started her on insulin right away. They also promised to send a prescription for diabetic food which I never got. I was left confused, trying to manage her care on my own.

And the staff? Absolutely no help. I asked if I could give my cat her sedatives before a visit (she gets very stressed and aggressive at vet visits) they said they’d ask the doctor and call me back. No one ever called me back. Also when my cat started vomiting non stop a few days after starting insulin, I called for help and got nothing. They said to keep an eye on her. I told them she's not holding down food and is lethargic. They asked if I wanted to make an appointment then. They did not care or were concerned about how my cat was acting. I had to take her to the SPCA clinic instead, where they actually listened and helped.

Trying to switch vets was another mess. They refused to send medical records in a timely way — my new vet and I both had to call multiple times. I kept getting told “the doctor forgot.” Seriously? That's just ridiculous and unprofessional.

Bottom line this: they care more about your wallet than your pet. Don’t waste your time or money here. Go to Fishtown Animal Hospital or the SPCA clinic— they’re kind, professional, and actually care.

And I know that they're going to respond to this review negatively and try to blame it on me like they do with other negative reviews., but this is just the truth. I have the vet bills to prove this and the bills from my new vet and the SPCA clinc to prove this.
Very good service helpful doctor & employee
The take care of our fur babies awesomely!
They are a caring, warm facility with a staff that knows how to treat their patients and their owners.
Excellent doctor, top-notch service and always attentive to his patients
I’ve taken both of my dogs and my cat there for routine as well as emergency visits. The staff take such good care of my babies!

Brought in a new kitty today. First time here. Appointment was easy to get. The office and exam rooms are very clean. The doctor was efficient and friendly. Everything was priced as stated. Could be slightly more communicative and less minimalist when describing everything. Overall very happy with the care.

In the 15 & over yrs I have been coming here the place changed ownership 3 times. This last owner who is the vet there now, I am by far the happiest with. First owner was affordable but not state of the art. 2nd owner had a different vet there everytime we went & their prices were astronomical! This new vet that bought the practice will be the only vet there & he is willing to workout a treatment plan that you can afford. Love this new vet & his staff. Would give 10stars if I could! Sandy & Jim Barnes.
UPDATE: Still love the vet & staff but prices are SOOO expensive! Each visit is never under $400. And in the past 6 mos I have had visits costing $800 & upwards. But prices have increased everywhere so I guess that's just the economy these days.
Customer Service is excellent

To be honest I didn’t have high expectations due to the area this is my back up vet, but I have been here twice and I am very pleased, staff of very attentive to my pet very informative and always very helpful
They took great care of Lilly

Went to Pet Health Center today with my cat who I believed to possibly have diabetes.  The staff and doctor were wonderful.  Kind and compassionate and answered all of my concerns.  The doctor suggested we take our cat Blue to emergency vet facility due to lab results being necessary to receive right away. He was very honest and that was comforting.  We took Blue to Blue Pearl emergency hospital in and was diagnosed with diabetes and will now be on insulin.  Our follow up appointments will be here at Pet Health Center. I highly recommend them.  Thank you for your care and concern for my fur baby.
Great place to bring your fur baby! Highly recommend.
They took good care of our dog

Where do I start we have lost 3 cats to the mistreatment of this vet clinic. The most recent our elder cat. The front desk receptionist (cassidy and Izabella) are very inconsiderate and rude they will not speak to the vet if you have a question or emergency and they don’t take into consideration that you are worried about your pet. I’ve watched them pull the same lies on the phone to other clients who call. This place needs to be shutdown !!!

The doctor always returns my calls and takes time to explain things to me. I have a very sick elderly dog and she is very medically time consuming. The doctor here is always eager to help. I think he really care about the animals.
Very accommodating, friendly and wonderful staff!!!
My favorite pet doctor.
Always kind and gentle with my 90# Bull Terrier who is horribly afraid of car rodes and the vet.

We took our cat TinkerBell there a year ago. To get spayed. When we went to pick her up, she had a HUGE gash in her chest. We asked what happened and they Saud, "I don't know she came in that way"! NO, NO SHE DIDNT. They then locked us in an exam room for over an hour.  Once they opened the door we ran directly our lives. And tinker bells
Great vet and helpful staffs. Been with this place for 3-4 animals care
I really appreciated the staff there, they were so pleasant and very accommodating. I suggest anyone who really cares about their pet’s health to and check it out!!!!
Roxy's had multiple good visits. Care, diagnosis and customer service is very good. Would recommend.
Everyone who works there is so nice. They take really good care of my dog

I’m a new client here. I called Wednesday for concerns for my doggo and they were so nice and flexible offering me a same day appointment as a new client! I’ve never seen that anywhere. I scheduled for the next day and there was absolutely no wait. We got on time and were seen on time. The staff were super nice and the Dr. was also very nice. He explained my options, gave alternative reasons as to why my dog may be acting the way she was, and explained next steps really well to someone with no medical back ground. The doctor was able to communicate with me on my level so I knew everything he was talking about. He also gave me an estimate, and for someone who has had multiple pets and emergency pricing scenarios they are very reasonably priced. Location isn’t the best area and parking is hard to find but leave early! Because it’s worth the hassle to be able to get your animals checked here. I look forward to moving my other pets over and moving forward with dental treatment for my doggie.
